※5⛬ said softly, his voice tinged with nervousness and excitement. ※1⛬ looked at him with some worry but still obeyed his command.

※5⛬ leaned against the cave wall and slowly sat down, feeling his body growing weaker and weaker.

※5⛬ felt the toxins spreading through his body, his vision gradually blurred, and his consciousness began to dissipate. He recalled his experiences over the past ten years,
